newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse closes flat in low volume.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse closes flat in low volume.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange closed little changed on Monday with poor sentiment keeping most traders on the sidelines, dealers said.
The market has languished at lower levels for the past week with volume continuing to dwindle.
The GSE All-Share Index just managed to stay in positive territory, adding 0.04 points to 364.20.
Turnover was 14,420 shares traded, a slight improvement on 13,280 at the last session on Friday.
Enterprise Insurance Co gained five cedis to 480 while conglomerate Uniliver added two cedis to 823. Home Finance Co dropped two cedis to close at 138.
